title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 24-A, Chapter 27 - The Insurance Contract (part of the Maine Insurance Code)
source_id: 24-A M.R.S. ch. 27 (§§ 2401-2453), esp. § 2436 (Interest on overdue payments) and § 2436-A (Unfair claims settlement practices)
verified_how: Fetched title24-Ach0sec0.html, which prints 'Title 24-A: MAINE INSURANCE CODE' and lists 'Chapter 27: THE INSURANCE CONTRACT (§2401 - §2453)', then title24-Ach27sec0.html, which prints 'Title 24-A, Chapter 27: THE INSURANCE CONTRACT' with '§2436 - Interest on overdue payments' and '§2436-A - Unfair claims settlement practices' live. Data extracted 10/20/2025; text current through October 1, 2025.
notes: §2436 sets the statutory interest and time limits for overdue claim payments and §2436-A the prohibited claims-handling practices - this chapter, not the trade-practices chapter (ch. 23, Trade Practices and Frauds, §§2151-2189), is where the claims rules sit in Maine. Line-specific claims rules are in chs. 33 (health), 39 (casualty) and 41 (property).
